query:
SELECT
             u.id,
             u.first_name,
             u.last_name,
             u.phone,
             u.email,
             CAST((
               SELECT COALESCE(
                 JSON_ARRAYAGG(
                   JSON_OBJECT(
                     'id', ua.id,
                     'type', ua.type,
                     'is_default', ua.is_default,
                     'first_name', ua.first_name,
                     'last_name', ua.last_name,
                     'phone', ua.phone,
                     'address', ua.address_json
                   )
                 ),
                 JSON_ARRAY()
               )
               FROM user_addresses ua
               WHERE ua.user_id = u.id
             ) AS CHAR) AS "addresses: String"
           FROM users u
           WHERE u.id = ?
